status_convention: Tasks live in a markdown table under '## Tasks'. No completion markers present in the source. To mark a task complete, append ' — DONE' suffix to the end of the Task column (column 2) of that row. status='pending' = no suffix; status='done' = ' — DONE' suffix; status='blocked' = ' — BLOCKED' suffix; status='skipped' = ' — SKIPPED' suffix.
